snp5.17:1.1: “I am old, without strength, with poor complexion,
snp5.17:1.3: my eyes are unclear, and hearing is difficult -
snp5.17:1.4: may I indeed not perish a fool mid-way!
snp5.17:1.5: Explain the Teaching so that I may know
snp5.17:1.6: the complete giving up of birth and old age here.”
snp5.17:2.1: “Having seen (people) being struck down amid forms,
snp5.17:2.3: (and that) heedless people are pained amid forms -
snp5.17:2.5: must give up form, and not come into existence again.”
snp5.17:3.1: “The four directions, the four intermediate directions, said venerable Piṅgiya,
snp5.17:3.2: above and below: in these ten directions,
snp5.17:3.3: there is nothing for you that is unseen, unheard,
snp5.17:3.4: unsensed, or uncognized in the world!
snp5.17:3.5: Explain the Teaching so that I may know
snp5.17:3.6: the complete giving up of birth and old age here.”
snp5.17:4.3: are tormented, and overcome by old age -
snp5.17:4.5: must give up craving and not come into existence again.”
